exact_items: Recommended mapping: History receives everything chronologically; Progress / Dashboard show active warnings / attention / blocked states; badges show compressed counts/severity markers; chat/thread surfaces only for things needing user decision; system notifications reserved for high-value, sparse events

project cards need compact pressure signals: provider/account pressure present, quota pressure severity, signal confidence if especially important
